title: IllegalStateException when adding quarkus-smallrye-openapi to a Quarkus Rest application
body:
I’m creating a Quarkus Rest application, with resteasy, Lombok, H2 db and Panache. I’m inserting data in the database during startup (AppLifecycleBean.java), and works when I run `mvn clean install -U`.

But when I add the OpenAPI dependency in pom.xml, I’m getting `org.jboss.resteasy.spi.UnhandledException: java.lang.IllegalStateException: This method is normally automatically overridden in subclasses: did you forget to annotate your entity with @Entity?`.

        at io.undertow.server.handlers.PredicateHandler.handleRequest(PredicateHandler.java:43)

To reproduce:  you can reproduce the error cloning my repository: https://github.com/andreybevilacqua/techstore (package "quarkus")
	1 - Clone the repository;
	2 - Go to quarkus package;
	3 - Build the application: `mvn clean install -U` (it will work correctly);
	4 - Uncomment the `quarkus-smallrye-openapi` dependency from pom.xml;
	5 - Try to build again: `mvn clean install -U` (or run tests on `TechStoreTest` class).

Environment:
	- java version “1.8.0_191” Java(TM) SE Runtime Environment (build 1.8.0_191-b12) Java HotSpot(TM) 64-Bit Server VM (build 25.191-b12, mixed mode);
	- Quarkus: 0.17.0;
	- Lombok: 1.18.8;
	- Maven: 3.5.4;
	- OS: mac os x 10.14.5, x86_64
